name: Fem, Gen, & Sex Studies (Min)

rules.name: Declaring the Minor
rules.desc: To declare the FGSS minor, the student must first email the Assistant Director of Student Services, who will guide the student through the steps of declaration. The student then must meet with the Director of Undergraduate Studies or the Faculty Director to develop and review their study plan. As the final step, the student declares the Minor on Axess.

rules.name: Core Required Course
rules.desc: Course must be taken for 4 or more units and a letter grade.

rules.name: Theory Requirement
rules.desc: Students must complete FEMGEN 103 or another approved theory course for 4 or more units and a letter grade.

rules.name: Minor Electives (16 units)
rules.desc:
Minors designate a minimum of 16 units from any of the approved FGSS course lists below. Courses can be all from one list or from different lists.
Students may petition to count courses outside of the course lists with approval from the Faculty Director. Please contact the FGSS Faculty Director and Director of Undergraduate Studies to confer about which courses are appropriate for your focus.

policies: The minor in Feminist, Gender, and Sexuality Studies consists of at least six courses for a minimum of 25 units. Units applied to the FGSS minor may not be double-counted toward the student’s major or any other minor.
transferPolicy: Units from courses taken from other departments/programs within Stanford may count for minor requirements on the approval of the Faculty Director. Units from courses taken at institutions that are not Stanford may count for minor requirements if the student petitions the course and the Faculty Director approves.
reviewNotes: The minor is FEMGEN 101 and a theory course (FEMGEN 103 or another listed one), each for at least 4 units and a letter grade, and 16 units from any of the FGSS course lists, for at least six courses and 25 units. Courses outside the lists, from other departments or from other schools, count with the Faculty Director's approval and are moved in by hand, and your advisor checks that none of these units also counts toward your major or another minor.
